privacy.title: Who operates this service
privacy.body: focalPoint is the study app provided by the developer identified on its Google Play or Apple App Store listing. Contact wealthconsort@gmail.com about privacy, your account or your study materials.

privacy.title: Account and study information
privacy.body: We process your email address, account identifier and name to provide and secure your account. If you choose Google sign-in, we receive the profile information Google provides for that sign-in. A phone number is optional. We store selected study preferences, exam results, topic outcomes and reminder settings to provide progress and account synchronisation.

privacy.title: Your papers and uploads
privacy.body: When you choose to upload photos, PDFs or question text, those materials are sent to the focalPoint server for processing and storage. The extraction service uses OpenRouter and its selected model providers to prepare questions. These providers process the submitted content under their own applicable terms and data practices. Upload only materials you have permission to use, and remove unrelated personal information before uploading.

privacy.title: On-device practice
privacy.body: Downloaded papers, unfinished exams, written answers and drawing-board working are stored on your device for offline study. Exam summaries and question outcomes can synchronise when you reconnect. A profile photo chosen from your phone is kept locally. Exporting a backup uses the destination or app you select; protect that exported file and any device backups.

privacy.title: Notifications and technical information
privacy.body: If you enable phone notifications, we process an installation identifier, push token and platform information to deliver messages and upload completion alerts through Expo and Apple or Firebase. You can turn notifications off in the app or system settings. Our hosting and authentication services also process network and security information, such as request IP addresses, necessary to operate and protect the service.

privacy.title: Service providers
privacy.body: We use Supabase for authentication and student account data, our VPS hosting provider for question materials and application processing, OpenRouter and selected model providers for extraction, and Expo, Firebase and Apple for notification delivery. Information can be processed in countries outside your own. We do not sell your personal data. Provider use and retention must be considered alongside this policy.

privacy.title: Your choices and deletion
privacy.body: You can remove saved papers and sessions in the app. To request deletion of your account and associated cloud profile, progress and private uploaded materials, open Help & privacy → Delete account, or email wealthconsort@gmail.com from your account email with the subject “focalPoint account deletion”. We verify ownership before deleting account data. Deleting local downloads or signing out alone does not delete your cloud account.

privacy.title: Retention and safety
privacy.body: Account and study information is retained while needed to provide your account and requested study materials, until removed or an account deletion request is fulfilled. Limited records may be retained where required for security or legal obligations; any applicable exception will be explained when processing your request. Data is transferred using encrypted connections. Device security, operating-system backups and third-party provider retention are separate considerations.

privacy.title: Children and families
privacy.body: Parents and guardians can contact wealthconsort@gmail.com about a child’s account, uploaded information, access or deletion. Where parental consent is legally required, it must be provided before a child’s personal information is submitted. Do not include unrelated personal information in question papers or photographs.

terms.title: Using focalPoint
terms.body: Use focalPoint for lawful study and revision. You are responsible for keeping your account secure and for having permission to upload or use your materials. Do not upload illegal, abusive or infringing content, or attempt to access another person’s account or materials.

terms.title: Questions and results
terms.body: Study materials and automated extraction can contain mistakes. Review extracted questions and answer keys before practice. Written/theory answers are not automatically marked unless the app explicitly provides that feature. Results are practice feedback and do not guarantee examination performance.

terms.title: Independent study app
terms.body: focalPoint is an independent study service. References to WAEC, UTME, JAMB, schools or other examination bodies identify study content; they do not imply endorsement or affiliation.

terms.title: Availability and payments
terms.body: An internet connection is required for sign-in, new downloads, uploads and synchronisation. Saved papers can be practised offline. The current release has no in-app purchase system; any future paid features will display their price and applicable purchase terms before payment.

terms.title: Support and reporting
terms.body: Report a question problem through the in-app Report action. Contact wealthconsort@gmail.com for account, content-rights or service concerns. The privacy policy explains how information is handled and how to request account deletion.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.body: Request deletion of your focalPoint account and its associated cloud profile, progress and private uploaded study materials. Send the request from the email registered to your account so ownership can be verified. Do not send your password or verification codes.

deletion.title: What happens next
deletion.body: The support team verifies ownership and processes the request. You will be told if any specific security or legal retention exception applies. Removing a saved paper from this phone, deleting a practice session or signing out does not delete your full account. Local copies and exported backups on other devices must be removed from those devices or destinations.
